description: Fix end-to-end real-time progress display: WebSocket URL points to wrong port, race condition loses messages, no polling fallback, 409 prevents retry.
steps: Fix WebSocket URL in frontend/src/services/websocket.ts to default to ws://localhost:8000 instead of ws://${window.location.host}
Fix race condition in frontend/src/pages/AnalysisPage.tsx: connect WebSocket FIRST, wait for open, THEN call startProcessing
Add getAnalysisStatus() to frontend/src/services/api.ts for REST polling
Add polling fallback in AnalysisPage.tsx: poll GET /api/analysis/{session_id}/status every 2 seconds
Remove 409 conflict in backend/src/api/routes/video.py: allow re-processing when in ANALYZING state by resetting to UPLOADED first
acceptance_criteria: WebSocket connects to backend port (8000) not frontend port (5173) in development
WebSocket is connected before processing starts so no progress messages are lost
Polling fallback fetches progress every 2 seconds as safety net
Video can be re-processed without 409 error even if status is ANALYZING
findings: All 215 backend tests and 30 frontend tests pass. Frontend build succeeds. Node 20 was installed via mise for running vitest (bun test lacks jsdom support). The vite.config.ts already had proxy config for /api and /ws to localhost:8000, but this only works in dev server mode - direct WebSocket connections from client-side code bypass the dev server proxy, so the explicit URL fix was still necessary. The mise.toml file was created in the frontend directory for node but not committed since it is environment-specific.
